item.title: agent-memory-kit: Replacing mem9 with Markdown and Git
item.description:
A few months ago, I wrote about self-hosting mem9 on AWS so the agents I use could share memory. I have now replaced that workflow with agent-memory-kit, a new project I have released under the MIT license.

The workstation side keeps memory as Markdown notes in a private Git repository. Each machine has a clone. Claude Code, Codex, and Kiro work with those files; agents outside the workstations can use an optional Memory API through an MCP gateway.
